description: Switch social networks and set their profile URLs (plain https only), then rewrite the Datenschutz social-media section; with nothing on, the section is removed. NOT a merge: every network missing from networks is switched off, so always send the full set you want on. Needs the modules imported and a Datenschutz document (409 otherwise). Returns the new state as legal_get_social does. Requires cvrt-legal 0.6.0+.

enabled.description: Network on/off; on needs at least one URL

urls.description: Profile URLs, plain https; blanks are dropped

networks.description: network key (as legal_get_social lists under available) => { enabled, urls }

name: legal_put_social
